title: Database Administrator
description: A comprehensive roadmap for operating reliable, high-performance, and secure databases across various environments, from on-premise to cloud.

tree.name: Essential IT Foundations for DBAs
tree.description: Build a strong understanding of underlying IT infrastructure crucial for database administration, including operating systems, networking, storage, and virtualization.

resources.title: Storage Basics: HDD vs SSD vs NVMe
Networking Fundamentals - CompTIA Network+ N10-008 - Full Course

children.name: Linux OS Administration for Databases
children.description: Master Linux command line, file systems, user/group management (sudoers), process management (systemd), package management (apt/yum), logging (journalctl), and essential system utilities for database server administration.

resources.title: Linux System Administration Basics - RHCSA - RHEL 8 Course

children.name: Linux System Utilities & Scripting
children.description: Utilize disk and memory management tools (df, du, free), CPU monitoring (top, htop), I/O monitoring (iostat, vmstat), and develop basic Bash scripts for automation and task scheduling (cron).

resources.title: Linux Commands Full Course for Beginners

children.name: Networking Fundamentals & Security
children.description: Understand TCP/IP, DNS, ports, firewalls (iptables/firewalld), routing, VPNs, basic load balancing concepts, and network troubleshooting tools (ping, traceroute, netstat, ss) relevant to database connectivity and security.

resources.title: Networking Basics for Beginners - An Introduction to Computer Networks (freeCodeCamp)

children.name: Server Hardware, Storage & Virtualization
children.description: Learn about CPU architectures, RAM, different storage technologies (HDD, SSD, NVMe, SAN, NAS), RAID levels, filesystems (ext4, XFS, ZFS), and their impact on database performance and reliability.

resources.title: Computer Hardware Full Course - Learn to Build a PC & More!

children.name: Virtualization & Containerization Basics
children.description: Introduction to virtualization concepts (VMware, KVM, Hyper-V) and containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes basics), understanding their role in deploying and managing databases.

resources.title: Docker Crash Course for Absolute Beginners

tree.name: Relational Database Fundamentals
tree.description: Deep dive into the core concepts of relational databases, including their architecture, transaction management, schema design, and essential SQL knowledge, with a focus on practical application in PostgreSQL.

resources.title: SQL Tutorial - Full Database Course for Beginners (freeCodeCamp)

children.name: Database Architecture & Internals
children.description: Understand storage engines, memory structures (buffers, caches, shared memory), process models, Write-Ahead Logging (WAL), transaction logs, data files, and physical file management. Focus on how these components interact in a relational database.

resources.title: Database Internals: How Database Stores Data? (Buffer Pool, WAL, LSM Trees, B Trees & More)

children.name: ACID, Transactions & Concurrency Control
children.description: Learn about Atomicity, Consistency, Isolation, Durability (ACID) properties, various transaction isolation levels (Read Committed, Repeatable Read, Serializable), locking mechanisms (row-level, table-level), and strategies for concurrency control including MVCC (Multi-Version Concurrency Control).

children.name: SQL Mastery & Advanced Querying (PostgreSQL)
children.description: Master DDL, DML, DCL, advanced joins, Common Table Expressions (CTEs), window functions, stored procedures, user-defined functions, triggers, and views. Understand query execution flow, basic optimization, and PostgreSQL-specific SQL extensions.

resources.title: PostgreSQL Advanced SQL Tutorial - Window Functions, CTEs, and more

children.name: Schema Design, Data Modeling & Constraints
children.description: Design efficient database schemas, apply normalization forms (1NF-3NF, BCNF), understand entity-relationship diagrams, choosing appropriate data types, defining constraints (PRIMARY KEY, FOREIGN KEY, UNIQUE, CHECK), and planning schema migrations (e.g., using Flyway or Liquibase).

children.name: Indexing Strategies & Maintenance
children.description: Learn about different index types (B-tree, Hash, GIN, GiST), when and how to use them, multi-column indexes, partial indexes, expression indexes, index-only scans, and their impact on query performance and storage. Understand index maintenance techniques like `REINDEX` and `VACUUM`.

resources.title: Database Indexing Explained - What is an Index in a Database?

children.name: PostgreSQL Configuration & Management
children.description: Understand PostgreSQL server configuration (`postgresql.conf`), client authentication (`pg_hba.conf`), user and role management, database creation, object privileges, and essential command-line tools like `psql`, `pg_dump`, `pg_restore`.

resources.title: PostgreSQL in 60 Minutes | PostgreSQL Crash Course

tree.name: Database Operations & Reliability Engineering
tree.description: Ensure continuous availability, data integrity, and operational efficiency through robust practices in backup, recovery, replication, monitoring, maintenance, automation, and capacity planning.

resources.title: Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) Book - Data Intensive Applications

children.name: Backup, Recovery & Disaster Recovery Strategies
children.description: Implement comprehensive backup policies (logical via pg_dump, physical via pg_basebackup/pgBackRest), perform various restore types (full, point-in-time recovery), define Recovery Point Objective (RPO) and Recovery Time Objective (RTO) objectives, and develop robust disaster recovery plans, including continuous archiving (WAL shipping).

resources.title: PostgreSQL Backup and Restore (pg_dump, pg_basebackup, PITR)
PostgreSQL Point in Time Recovery (PITR) with WAL Archiving

children.name: Replication, High Availability (HA) & Load Balancing
children.description: Configure and manage various replication methods (streaming physical replication, logical replication), understand master-replica topologies, implement automatic failover with quorum-based solutions, and ensure high availability with tools like Patroni, Pgpool-II, or repmgr. Explore load balancing and connection pooling for distributed environments.

resources.title: PostgreSQL High Availability, Load Balancing, and Replication
Patroni: A Template for PostgreSQL High Availability
Patroni PostgreSQL Tutorial - Automatic Failover for PostgreSQL

children.name: Database Monitoring, Logging & Alerting
children.description: Set up robust monitoring for key database metrics (CPU, RAM, I/O, connections, query performance, replication lag, table/index bloat), configure intelligent alerts, and build insightful dashboards using tools like Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or Pgbadger. Understand database log analysis for troubleshooting.

children.name: Database Patching & Version Upgrades
children.description: Plan and execute database patching, minor/major version upgrades (e.g., using pg_upgrade). Understand impact analysis, develop comprehensive test procedures, and create rollback strategies to minimize downtime and risk. Familiarity with database vendor release cycles.

resources.title: PostgreSQL Full Upgrade with pg_upgrade - Major Version Database Upgrade

children.name: Automation for DBAs & Infrastructure as Code
children.description: Automate routine DBA tasks using scripting (Bash, Python), cron jobs, and configuration management tools (e.g., Ansible, Chef, Puppet). Embrace Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles with tools like Terraform to manage database infrastructure provision, deployment, and configuration, improving efficiency, consistency, and reducing human error.

resources.title: Python for DevOps: Automating DB Tasks
Terraform Course - From BEGINNER to PRO! (Learn Terraform with Examples)
Ansible Tutorial for Beginners - Learn DevOps with Ansible

children.name: Capacity Planning, Scaling & Partitioning
children.description: Forecast database growth, plan for resource allocation (storage, CPU, memory, network), and understand horizontal (sharding) and vertical scaling strategies to meet future demands. Implement table partitioning for performance and manageability of large datasets.

resources.title: Database Sharding - System Design Interview Concept

children.name: Practice Lab: Operational Drill
children.description: Perform a full backup and point-in-time restore, simulate a failover to a replica, identify and resolve a replication lag issue, perform a minor version upgrade on a test cluster, and document the steps and lessons learned in a runbook format.

resources.title: PostgreSQL Physical Streaming Replication on AWS EC2 - Failover Test
MySQL Backup and Recovery Tutorial | Point-in-Time Recovery with Binary Log

tree.name: Database Performance & Security Optimization
tree.description: Optimize database performance at all levels (query, server, OS) and implement robust security measures to protect sensitive data, ensure compliance with industry standards, and maintain a strong security posture.

resources.title: SQL Performance Tuning Tutorial For Beginners | Learn SQL Performance Tuning For Free
Database Security Tutorial | Learn Database Security in 1 Hour

children.name: Query Performance Tuning & Optimization
children.description: Utilize `EXPLAIN`/`EXPLAIN ANALYZE` deeply to interpret query plans, identify bottlenecks, optimize complex SQL queries, manage database statistics (ANALYZE/VACUUM ANALYZE), tune optimizer parameters, and understand workload-aware tuning and profiling tools.

resources.title: SQL Query Optimization - Full Course for Beginners

children.name: Database Server & OS-Level Tuning
children.description: Configure database server parameters (e.g., `shared_buffers`, `work_mem`, `effective_cache_size`, `checkpoint` settings, `maintenance_work_mem`) and OS-level settings (kernel parameters like `shmmax`, `shmall`, `vm.swappiness`, I/O schedulers, NUMA awareness) for maximum performance and resource utilization.

resources.title: Linux Kernel Tuning for Database Servers
PostgreSQL Performance Tuning: Top 5 Parameters (Must Watch)
Linux Kernel Tuning for Database Performance

children.name: Database Security, Access Control & Authentication
children.description: Implement robust user/role management, grant/revoke permissions with the principle of least privilege, manage secrets effectively (e.g., using HashiCorp Vault), and configure secure client authentication methods (e.g., SSL certificates, Kerberos, LDAP, MFA). Explore Row-Level Security (RLS).

resources.title: PostgreSQL Tutorial for Beginners - Full Course
MySQL Crash Course | Learn MySQL in one video

children.name: Data Encryption, Masking & Compliance
children.description: Understand data encryption at rest (filesystem or TDE) and in transit (SSL/TLS), manage certificates, implement data masking/redaction and tokenization for sensitive information, and navigate complex compliance requirements such as GDPR, HIPAA, PCI DSS, and SOC 2.

children.name: Auditing, Vulnerability Management & Security Patching
children.description: Configure detailed database auditing (e.g., with pgaudit), review audit logs for anomalies and suspicious activities, conduct regular vulnerability assessments and penetration testing, and establish a rigorous security patching cycle to mitigate known risks effectively. Understand common database attack vectors (e.g., SQL Injection, privilege escalation).

resources.title: OWASP Top 10 for Web Application Security

tree.name: Cloud Databases & Advanced Incident Management
tree.description: Specialize in managing databases in various cloud environments, leveraging cloud-native features, and developing robust incident response capabilities for complex production scenarios.

children.name: Managed Database Services Deep Dive
children.description: Explore and compare major cloud-managed relational database services (AWS RDS/Aurora, Google Cloud SQL, Azure Database for PostgreSQL). Understand their features, architecture (multi-AZ/regional deployments), serverless options, automated backups, parameter groups, maintenance windows, and shared responsibilities model.

children.name: Cloud Database Operations, Cost Optimization & IaC
children.description: Learn cloud-specific monitoring strategies and tools (CloudWatch, Stackdriver, Azure Monitor), scaling patterns (read replicas, auto-scaling, serverless options), high availability patterns in the cloud, and advanced cost management/optimization for managed database services. Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) for cloud database provisioning (e.g., with Terraform or CloudFormation).

children.name: Database Migration Strategies to/from Cloud
children.description: Understand various strategies and tools for migrating databases to the cloud (e.g., AWS DMS, Azure Migrate, Google Cloud Database Migration Service) or between different cloud providers/on-premise. Cover online/offline migrations, zero-downtime migration patterns, data integrity checks, and planning for hybrid cloud database environments.

children.name: Incident Management, Runbooks & Post-Mortems
children.description: Develop and utilize detailed incident runbooks for common and complex database issues (slow queries, replication lag, storage exhaustion, failed backups, performance degradation). Practice structured incident response, conduct thorough root cause analysis, and lead effective post-mortems to learn from failures and implement preventative measures.

children.name: Project: Advanced Cloud Database Operations Lab
children.description: Provision a highly available and scalable database cluster in a chosen cloud environment (e.g., AWS RDS/Aurora) using Infrastructure as Code. Implement comprehensive backup/restore with PITR, configure advanced monitoring and alerting, simulate and resolve a complex database incident, and document an operational runbook and post-mortem report.

tree.name: Specialized & Emerging Database Technologies
tree.description: Explore specialized areas and emerging trends in the database landscape, broadening your expertise beyond traditional relational systems to address diverse data management needs and modern architectures.

children.name: NoSQL Databases Deep Dive
children.description: Understand different NoSQL types (document, key-value, columnar, graph), their use cases, and when to choose them over relational databases. Deep dive into operational aspects of popular NoSQL systems like MongoDB (document), Cassandra (columnar), and Redis (key-value/in-memory data structure store).

children.name: Data Warehousing, Data Lakes & ETL/ELT
children.description: Introduction to data warehousing concepts, OLAP vs. OLTP, star/snowflake schemas, and the Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) and Extract, Load, Transform (ELT) processes for analytical workloads. Understand the role of data lakes and modern data stack components.

children.name: Search, Graph & Time-Series Databases
children.description: Explore specialized database types: Search databases (e.g., Elasticsearch, OpenSearch) for full-text search and analytics, Graph databases (e.g., Neo4j, Amazon Neptune) for relational data, and Time-Series databases (e.g., InfluxDB, TimescaleDB) for monitoring and IoT data.

children.name: Distributed SQL Databases
children.description: Understand the architecture and benefits of Distributed SQL databases (e.g., CockroachDB, YugabyteDB, Vitess), which combine relational database features with horizontal scalability and global distribution.

children.name: Polyglot Persistence & Data Strategy
children.description: Understand the concept of using multiple data storage technologies within a single application or system, each best suited for a particular data workload or domain. Learn to define a comprehensive data strategy for complex microservices architectures.
